title: Green Light for Carnival; Water Main Bids Reviewed
summary:
*   Granted permission for the Jack Schafer Carnival Company to operate on East Avenue between Fifth and Sixth Streets.
*   City engineers reviewed bids for the installation of 1,000 lineal feet of new 24-inch water main.
*   Recommended accepting a bid of $7,145.10 from Kirkwood & Wharton, citing significant cost savings and a faster completion time compared to other proposals.

The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the fol lowing members

The application of the Jack Schafer Carnival Company, by the Board of Directors of the
Texas State Exposition, asking for permission to show on East Avenue between Fifth and
Sixth Streets was read and Councilman Avery moved that same be granted. Motion prevailed
by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Avery, Haynes, Nolen and Searight, 5;
nayes, none, The Council then recessed.
